**[GD14502](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14502-adddatatypes-workbench-argument-loop-never-advances) — AddDataTypes never advances the Workbench argument counter and walks beyond `sm_ArgList` for a nonempty startup argument list. Source-only; see the full-body pass in the [Graphics/Desktop coverage ledger](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#adddatatypes-command-full-body-descriptor-and-startup-review-2026-11-03).**

**[GD14503](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14503-adddatatypes-leaks-allocation-on-header-decode-failure) — AddDataTypes leaks its unlinked descriptor allocation when DTHD decoding fails. Source-only; see the full-body pass in the [Graphics/Desktop coverage ledger](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#adddatatypes-command-full-body-descriptor-and-startup-review-2026-11-03).**


**[GD14504](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14504-adddatatypes-reads-fixed-header-from-short-dthd-property) — AddDataTypes decodes the fixed 32-byte datatype header without checking the DTHD property size, allowing short properties to drive out-of-bounds source reads and destination writes. Source-only; see the [full-body coverage entry](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#adddatatypes-command-full-body-descriptor-and-startup-review-2026-11-03).**


**[GD14505](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14505-adddatatypes-does-not-validate-dthd-payload-offsets) — AddDataTypes uses DTHD string and mask offsets without validating their bounds or string termination against the payload. Source-only; see the [full-body coverage entry](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#adddatatypes-command-full-body-descriptor-and-startup-review-2026-11-03).**


**[GD14506](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14506-adddatatypes-returns-success-after-descriptor-processing-failures) — AddDataTypes reports success after descriptor loads or directory traversal fail, hiding partial activation from callers. Source-only; see the [full-body coverage entry](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#adddatatypes-command-full-body-descriptor-and-startup-review-2026-11-03).**


**[GD14507](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14507-datatype-open-count-mutates-under-shared-lock) — DataType OpenCount increments/decrements use a shared semaphore, allowing lost reference updates that can let AddDataTypes replace a still-referenced descriptor. Source-only; see the [full-body coverage entry](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#datatype-api-wrapper-and-reference-count-full-body-pass-2026-11-03).**


**[GD9618](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd9618) — BestModeIDA ignores its documented BIDTAG_GreenBits minimum. Source-only; see the [caller and full-body recheck](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#intuition-diagnostic-and-graphics-mode-selection-full-body-pass-2026-11-03).**




**[GD5923](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd5923) — QBlit/QBSBlit queues have no consumer on selected targets other than AmigaVideo; no maintained caller is known. Default amiga-m68k uses `standcompat` and receives the synthetic kick. Source-only.**

**[GD14510](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14510-obtainbestpena-overflows-color-distance-scaling) — ObtainBestPenA can overflow its distance × free-pen comparison; OpenScreen accepts a 32,767-entry palette size that reaches the wraparound path. Source-only; see the [full-body coverage entry](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#graphics-low-level-api-and-blitter-queue-full-body-pass-2026-11-03).**


**[GD14511](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14511-compositor-selects-mode-with-stale-dimensions) — Compositor mode selection can pair the chosen mode ID with dimensions saved from an earlier candidate when equal resolution scores are broken by depth. Source-only; see the [full-body pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#compositor-display-mode-selection-full-body-pass-2026-11-03).**


**[GD14512](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14512-compositor-rebuilds-regions-under-shared-lock) — Compositor position changes rebuild shared region lists while holding a shared/read lock, allowing concurrent bitmap redraw traversal to overlap the mutation on ExecSMP. Source-only; see the [lock/caller pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#compositor-position-and-bitmap-redraw-lock-pass-2026-11-03).**


**[GD14513](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14513-waitx-fails-to-carry-month-overflow-into-year) — WaitX applies modulo before calculating the year carry, so recurring month intervals can schedule in the wrong year or fail validation. Explicit `workbench-c-sh` target; source-only.**

**[GD14514](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14514-waitx-never-closes-utility-library) — WaitX opens `utility.library` but never closes it, retaining an open reference after each invocation. Explicit `workbench-c-sh` target; source-only.**


**[GD14515](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14515-logger-discards-buffer-after-flush-error) — Logger clears its buffer even when seek/write fails or only part of the log data is written, losing entries. Explicit `workbench-c-logger` target; source-only.**


**[GD14516](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14516-psi-does-not-clear-text-mode-info) — Public Screen Inspector uses the String contents attribute to clear TextObjects; switching to `INVALID_ID` therefore leaves the old mode details visible. Optional `workbench-prefs-psi` target; source-only.**
**[GD14517](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14517-compositor-continues-mode-selection-after-stack-allocation-failure) — On the first bitmap-stack allocation failure, Compositor still selects a mode with an empty stack and passes an uninitialized sync object to OOP_GetAttr before its fallback. Optional Compositor target; source-only.**
**[GD14518](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14518-compositor-does-not-handle-failed-bitmap-mode-lookup) — Compositor ignores a failed mode lookup for an accepted compositable custom bitmap, then reads attributes through NULL pixel-format/sync outputs. Optional Compositor target; source-only.**
**[GD14519](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14519-compositor-retains-alpha-state-across-bitmap-stack-replacement) — Replacing an alpha compositor stack with a non-alpha stack leaves HASALPHA set through mode selection, which can choose the wrong display size and retain the old alpha intermediate. Optional Compositor target; source-only.**
**[GD14520](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14520-compositor-accepts-composition-bitmap-allocation-failure) — On no-framebuffer Compositor targets, failed display-bitmap allocation is reported as success and the requested stack is not shown; if a previous screen exists, Graphics.library can also record stale front-bitmap state. Optional target and allocation-failure trigger; source-only.**
**[GD14521](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14521-compositor-silently-skips-redraw-when-region-allocation-fails) — If the initial composition redraw cannot allocate its temporary region or its first rectangle, the compositor still shows the newly allocated, unrendered composition bitmap. Optional target; allocation-failure trigger; source-only.**
**[GD14522](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14522) — `GetDisplayInfoData()` shifts an `int` by 32 when RGB masks use 32 bits, so its `PaletteRange` result is undefined instead of reliably saturating. Conditional on an HIDD exposing a 32-bit RGB mode; optional LinuxFB forwards host bitfield lengths, but no such host mode or in-tree consumer was established. See the [query review](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#displayinfo-palette-range-full-width-shift-gd14522). Source-only.


**[OD4087](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4087-eaudio-forgets-earlier-live-channel-allocations) — Optional eaudio replaces its global active-channel mask after each allocation, so a later request can select and reset channels still owned by an earlier client. Explicit eaudio build and external/future three-allocation trigger; not a default-image claim. Source-only.**


**[GD14523](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14523) — Headless graphics HIDD can report successful registration after display-object allocation fails.** The HIDD object remains published with a NULL default display; Graphics.library accepts it and the monitor loader returns success, blocking retry. Optional Headless HIDD; allocation-failure condition. See the [full-body registration trace](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#headless-gfx-full-body-registration-failure-pass-gd14523-2026-11-03). Source-only.


**[GD14524](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14524) — Calculator decimal input after an operator/result does not start a fresh operand.** A following digit clears the old buffer and loses the decimal point, so `1 + . 5 =` computes as `1 + 5`. Selected Calculator tool; source-only. See the [full-body review](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#calculator-full-body-decimal-and-tape-input-pass-gd14524-gd14525).

**[GD14525](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14525) — Calculator's 320-byte tape-name copy can omit its terminator.** Later `strlen()`/`Open()` use an unterminated array for a sufficiently long `TAPE/K` argument. Selected CLI tool; oversized argument acceptance is not verified. Source-only. See the [full-body review](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#calculator-full-body-decimal-and-tape-input-pass-gd14524-gd14525).


**[GD14526](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14526) — GraphicDump indexes its 12-entry error-name table with signed printer I/O errors.** Negative I/O codes and defined printer codes above 11 read outside the table during error reporting. Selected tool; source-only. See the [full-body review](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#graphicdump-full-body-printer-error-input-pass-gd14526-gd14527).

**[GD14527](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14527) — GraphicDump converts a negative delay to an enormous unsigned tick count.** `/N` input is read as `LONG`, stored in `ULONG`, multiplied by 50 and passed to DOS Delay. Selected CLI tool; source-only. See the [full-body review](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#graphicdump-full-body-printer-error-input-pass-gd14526-gd14527).


**[GD14528](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14528) — PrintFiles returns success after printer-open or datatype-print failures.** It logs/skips the failed operation but `main()` still returns zero on CLI and Workbench paths. Selected tool; source-only. See the [printer utility full-body pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#printer-utilities-and-printfiles-full-body-pass-gd14528).


**[OD11185](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11185) — i8042's expunge path never closes its successful utility.library open reference.** The null check is inverted. All-PC i8042 HIDD; source-only. See the [full-body lifecycle review](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#i8042-hidd-full-body-and-lifecycle-pass-od11185-od11188).

**[OD11186](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11186) — i8042 keyboard/mouse constructors can block forever when NewCreateTask fails.** They wait for a signal after ignoring the documented NULL failure result; no worker exists to signal. All-PC i8042 HIDD; allocation-failure condition. Source-only. See the [full-body lifecycle review](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#i8042-hidd-full-body-and-lifecycle-pass-od11185-od11188).

**[OD11187](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11187) — i8042's ACPI disable flags are set after device registration starts.** Priority-10 initialization reads the flags before the priority-20 ACPI probe sets them. All-PC i8042 HIDD with ACPICA; source-only. See the [full-body lifecycle review](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#i8042-hidd-full-body-and-lifecycle-pass-od11185-od11188).

**[OD11188](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11188) — i8042 leaks an opened timer request and message port when mouse detection fails.** The failure unwinds the HIDD object without closing/deleting those resources. All-PC i8042 HIDD without a detected PS/2 mouse; source-only. See the [full-body lifecycle review](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#i8042-hidd-full-body-and-lifecycle-pass-od11185-od11188).


**[EK10619](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10619) — PC BattClock ignores the RTC 12/24-hour mode and PM bit.** If the compatible RTC is left in 12-hour mode, reads produce a wrong hour and writes use the incompatible 0–23 format. All-PC BattClock; source-only. See the [full-body time-format pass](AROS-exec-kernel-coverage.md#pc-battclock-full-body-time-format-pass-ek10619).


**[EK10620](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10620) — The optional Hyper-V debugger's `tasklist` command calls `kprintf` with `%s` but supplies no string argument.** The formatter reads an unspecified pointer while handling the debugger exception, so the report can be corrupted or fault. Requires explicitly enabling and packaging the optional x86-64 PC debugger. Source-only. See the [task-list full-body pass](AROS-exec-kernel-coverage.md#hyperv-debugger-task-list-and-helper-full-body-pass-ek10700).

**[GD14529](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14529-mount-readfile-can-loop-forever-after-short-read) — Mount can spin forever if a mount definition reaches EOF before the length measured by `Seek()`.** The read loop does not handle a zero-byte result and makes no progress. Conditional on a concurrent file change or early-EOF handler; explicit `workbench-c` target. Source-only. See the [full-body Mount pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#mount-command-full-body-parser-and-handler-pass).

**[GD14530](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14530-version-misindexes-arm-floating-point-attributes) — Version's ARM `ARCH` output shifts `Tag_FP_arch` labels and reads beyond the FPU-name table for valid value 6.** Conditional on explicit `workbench-c` ARM builds with `ARCH`; source-only. See the [full-body Version pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#version-full-body-file-scanner-and-elf-pass).

**[GD14531](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14531-version-trusts-elf-section-header-entry-size) — Version can read beyond its loaded ELF section-header table when `e_shentsize` is smaller than the parser structure.** Conditional on malformed ARM ELF input to `ARCH`; source-only. See the [full-body Version pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#version-full-body-file-scanner-and-elf-pass).


**[GD14532](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14532-install-uses-a-device-node-after-unlocking-the-dos-list) — Install retains a borrowed DeviceNode after dropping the DOS-list lock, while `Assign DISMOUNT` can remove and free it. Conditional on concurrent use on ExecSMP. See the [full-body Install pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#install-command-full-body-device-and-blocklist-pass). Source-only.


**[GD14533](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14533-planarbm-fill-can-loop-forever-at-the-largest-row-coordinate) — Generic PlanarBM's Copy-mode fill increments a signed `WORD` beyond row 32,767 and never exits. Conditional on a 32,768-row planar bitmap and a fill reaching its final row. [Full-body bitmap-class pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#chunkybm-and-planarbm-full-body-pixel-allocation-and-bounds-pass). Source-only.

**[GD14534](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14534-planarbm-image-loops-do-not-advance-past-constant-one-planes) — Generic PlanarBM image read/write loops skip every backed plane after a constant-one plane because `continue` bypasses plane-pointer advancement. Conditional on mixed constant/backed planes. [Full-body bitmap-class pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#chunkybm-and-planarbm-full-body-pixel-allocation-and-bounds-pass). Source-only.

**[GD14535](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14535-chunkybm-truncates-its-owned-buffer-size) — Generic ChunkyBM truncates a >4 GiB backing-size product to 32-bit `ULONG` during initial allocation or resize, and can expose a small undersized buffer. Conditional on large HIDD-backed dimensions and subsequent image access. [Full-body bitmap-class pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#chunkybm-and-planarbm-full-body-pixel-allocation-and-bounds-pass). Source-only.


**[GD14536](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14536-getvpmodeid-dereferences-an-unassigned-viewport) — `GetVPModeID()` dereferences `RasInfo` when called on an initialized but unattached viewport, although the API result allows `INVALID_ID`. [Graphics helper full-body pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#graphics-helper-vectors-full-body-mode-region-and-gels-pass). Source-only.

**[OD11189](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11189) — DHCP minires accepts a presentation name ending in a lone escape.** A malformed trailing backslash is silently discarded during name conversion.
**[OD11190](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11190) — DHCP minires unpack writes a root terminator with a zero-byte destination.** The root-only path skips capacity checks before its final output byte.
**[OD11191](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11191) — GV100-family GR context setup counts active PPCs as a contiguous prefix.** Sparse physical PPC masks can hide live TPCs from SM enumeration and context SM-ID mapping. Conditional on supported hardware reporting such a topology; Nouveau GV100, TU102 and GA102 paths. [Topology trace](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#gv100-family-sparse-ppc-sm-id-topology-trace-od11191). Source-only; no GPU or build was run.
**[OD11192](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11192) — GA102 GR leaks its NET firmware image when an ACR loader fails.** The firmware reference is released only on the success path. Conditional on FECS or GPCCS ACR loading failing; GA102-family Nouveau. [Full loader/error-path trace](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#nouveau-ga102-gr-full-body-netlist-and-firmware-error-path-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.
**[OD11193](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11193) — GR firmware loaders discard netlist conversion errors.** Failed allocations or conversion leave required register packs absent while firmware setup reports success. GK20A/GM20B and GA102 paths; hardware consequence unverified. [Converter trace](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#gr-netlist-conversion-return-path-trace-od11193). Source-only.
**[OD11194](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11194) — Nouveau GR operations continue after bounded idle or FE power-transition waits time out.** Wait errors are discarded before more context, pipe, tile, or channel-teardown operations. NV04/NV05, NV10/NV11/NV15/NV17/NV18, nForce-family, and NV20/NV25/NV28/NV2A/NV30/NV31/NV34/NV35/NV36 and NV40/NV44-family paths, plus GF100-family/GK20A/GM20B context generators; hardware consequence unverified. [Caller trace](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#nouveau-gr-context-bounded-wait-callers-od11194). Source-only.
**[OD11195](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11195) — GK20A method-list conversion rejects its 16th class.** A capacity guard rejects a class list that fits the allocated table; the suppressed error leaves converted method initialization absent. Conditional on a selected firmware list with exactly 16 classes. [Converter trace](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#nouveau-gk20a-gr-full-body-method-converter-and-loader-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.
**[OD11196](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11196) — NV04 operation validation checks the class at object zero instead of the active object.** Mixed old/new graphics-object classes can make operations 3–5 incorrectly accepted or rejected on NV04/NV05. [Full GR method and context-switch pass](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#nouveau-nv04-gr-full-body-method-and-context-switch-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.
**[OD11197](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11197) — NV17 GR channel initialization skips context-register array index zero.** The first channel load writes zero to `NV10_PGRAPH_DEBUG_4` instead of retaining the initialized per-channel value. Scoped to selected NV17-family paths satisfying the existing generation predicate. [Full NV10 GR context pass](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#nouveau-nv10-gr-full-body-pipe-context-and-idle-caller-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.
**[OD11198](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11198) — NV40 suspend timeout clears active context state without rollback.** On a context-program timeout, channel fini clears the current-context marker before reporting failure; the channel has no init callback to restore it when suspend aborts. [NV40 suspend rollback trace](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#nouveau-nv40-gr-context-program-and-suspend-rollback-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.
**[OD11199](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11199) — G84-family GR TLB flush can report success before invalidation completes.** A bounded completion wait is ignored, and the VMM treats GR timeout results as handled, so a failed invalidate can be accepted after page-table changes. Shared by G84/G92, GT200, GT215 and MCP89 paths. [G84 flush/caller trace](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#nouveau-g84-gr-full-body-tlb-flush-and-vmm-caller-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.
**[OD11200](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11200) — Atheros5000 interrupt consumers bypass SMP shared-list locking.** RX/read, orphan, management-read, data-TX, management-TX, and event soft interrupts access message-port lists without the shared lock used by `PutMsg()`; packet callbacks also walk the opener list while close can unlink and free an opener under local `Disable()` only. This permits conditional cross-CPU list and opener-lifetime races when built with ExecSMP (confirmed path for x86 PC). [Full unit-body/message-port trace](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#atheros5000-unit-full-body-and-message-port-smp-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.
**[OD11201](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11201) — Atheros5000 per-type TX statistics count each data packet twice.** `TXInt()` counts a packet at submission and `TXEndInt()` counts it again at completion; `S2_GETTYPESTATS` reports both. [Full unit-body TX-statistics trace](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#atheros5000-unit-full-body-and-message-port-smp-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.
**[OD11202](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11202) — Atheros5000 type-tracker removal may race with interrupt-side stats on ExecSMP.** The request task frees the final tracker under local `Disable()`, while RX/TX soft interrupts access the list without a shared lock. The x86 PC SMP idle dispatcher can deliver shared queued soft interrupts on another CPU, and the unit task has no affinity. [Cross-CPU dispatch and tracker-lifetime trace](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#atheros5000-od11202-cross-cpu-dispatch-qualification-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14539](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14539-iconx-resolves-workbench-arguments-relative-to-the-script-directory) — IconX resolves Workbench arguments relative to the script directory.** Extra files from other drawers can be omitted or resolved to a same-named file beside the script. [Full-body IconX command and WBArg trace](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#iconx-full-body-script-status-pass). Explicit `workbench-c` target; source-only.
**[GD14540](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14540-gfxfree-leaves-a-color-map-view-extra-pointer-stale) — GfxFree can leave a ColorMap pointing at a freed ViewPortExtra.** Set `VTAG_VIEWPORTEXTRA_SET` before attaching a ViewPort, then explicitly free the extra; `FreeColorMap()` later passes the stale pointer back to `GfxFree()`. Conditional on that supported public API sequence; source-only.
**[GD14541](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14541-readpixelarray8-declares-a-word-result-for-a-long-pixel-count) — ReadPixelArray8 declares a WORD result for a LONG pixel count.** Counts above the signed WORD range can be narrowed or become negative for callers; ReadPixelLine8 forwards the result. [Signature reconciliation](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#graphics-conf-selected-function-list-signature-and-vector-reconciliation-2026-11-03). Source-only.
**[GD14542](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14542-which-all-skips-later-search-categories) — `Which ALL` can omit matches from later search categories.** The `found` guards prevent resident matches from continuing to path searches and path matches from continuing to the separate `C:` multiassign search, even with `ALL` set. Scoped to the explicit `workbench-c` target. [Full-body traversal pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#which-full-body-and-all-category-traversal-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.
**[GD14543](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14543-setclock-never-closes-timer-device) — SetClock leaves timer.device open.** After a successful `OpenDevice()`, it deletes the I/O request without `CloseDevice()`, leaking an open reference per invocation. Scoped to the explicit `workbench-c` target. [Full-body cleanup pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#setclock-full-body-and-process-state-pass). Source-only.
**[GD14544](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14544-setdefaultfont-screen-replacement-leaks-previous-font) — SetDefaultFont leaks a replaced default screen font.** Replacing Intuition's stored screen-font pointer does not release the prior opened disk font, leaving its accessor reference outstanding. Scoped to repeated `SetDefaultFont SCREEN` calls in the explicit `workbench-c` target. [Full-body font-lifetime pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#setdefaultfont-full-body-and-screen-font-replacement-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.
**[GD14545](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14545-rename-continues-after-break-between-source-patterns) — Rename keeps processing later sources after Ctrl-C.** In a multi-source rename to a directory, `ERROR_BREAK` ends only the current pattern; later patterns run and can overwrite the saved break state, leading to additional renames and a success return. Scoped to explicit `workbench-c` builds. [Full-body match/signal trace](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#rename-full-body-pattern-cleanup-and-ctrl-c-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.
**[GD14546](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14546-sort-uses-examined-size-after-short-read) — Sort parses past the bytes actually read.** It checks only for `Read() == -1`, then sorts the full earlier `Examine()` size, so a short read includes uninitialized buffer contents. Conditional on an input truncation or short filesystem read in explicit `workbench-c` builds. [Full-body I/O pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#sort-full-body-io-allocation-and-short-read-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14547](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14547-sort-null-fib-after-allocation-failure) — Sort may pass a null FIB to Examine.** If FIB allocation fails while IoErr is zero, Sort continues; the selected RAM filesystem then writes through the null FIB. Conditional on allocation failure and IoErr state in explicit `workbench-c` builds. [Full-body allocation trace](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#sort-full-body-io-allocation-and-short-read-pass). Source-only.

**[GD14548](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14548-run-drops-continuation-after-allocation-failure) — Run can launch only the first part of a continued command.** If its continuation-buffer allocation fails, it retains the original command and proceeds to launch it, silently dropping buffered text. Conditional on allocation failure in the selected shell command. [Full-body continuation pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#run-shell-command-full-body-continuation-and-handle-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14549](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14549-execute-drops-continuation-after-allocation-failure) — Execute can run a script without buffered continuation arguments.** If the combined argument-buffer allocation fails, it keeps and injects only the initial arguments, then reports success. Conditional on buffered continuation input and allocation failure. [Full-body pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#execute-shell-command-full-body-continuation-and-cleanup-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14550](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14550-execute-leaks-combined-continuation-buffer) — Execute leaks its combined continuation buffer.** After copying the combined text into the CLI input buffer, the command returns without freeing the temporary allocation. Repeated continued invocations accumulate memory. [Full-body pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#execute-shell-command-full-body-continuation-and-cleanup-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14551](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14551-path-reset-frees-the-next-list-node) — Path RESET frees the next path-list node before using it.** With at least two entries, RESET advances into an already freed node, risking invalid unlocks or a fault; it also leaks the first node. [Full-body list traversal](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#path-shell-command-full-body-list-and-allocation-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14552](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14552-path-can-examine-a-null-fib-after-allocation-failure) — Path may pass a null FIB to Examine.** Its DOS_FIB allocation is unchecked; the selected RAM handler writes through the FIB pointer. Conditional on allocation failure. [Full-body allocation trace](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#path-shell-command-full-body-list-and-allocation-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14553](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14553-path-leaks-fib-when-examine-fails) — Path leaks its FIB when Examine fails.** The only FIB free is inside the success branch. Conditional on handler Examine failure after locking a candidate path. [Full-body cleanup trace](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#path-shell-command-full-body-list-and-allocation-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14554](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14554-setenv-hides-global-variable-listing-failures) — Setenv and UnSetEnv report success when global-variable listing fails.** Their no-argument `ENV:` listings skip FIB allocation and `Examine()` failures, and do not distinguish an `ExNext()` error from normal end-of-list. Conditional on those failures. [Full-body listing/status pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#setenv-shell-command-full-body-listing-and-status-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14555](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14555-resident-leaves-forbid-active-on-removal-and-replace-paths) — Resident leaves `Forbid()` unbalanced on REMOVE and REPLACE fall-through paths.** Successful removal, failed removal, and a REPLACE miss return or continue without balancing the command's forbid count. Task switching remains disabled on the local processor. [Full-body path audit](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#resident-shell-command-full-body-resident-list-and-cleanup-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14556](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14556-resident-leaks-snapshot-nodes-on-list-allocation-failure) — Resident leaks partial list snapshots after allocation failure.** If a later snapshot allocation fails, earlier nodes and duplicated names are abandoned on the error return. [Full-body ownership pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#resident-shell-command-full-body-resident-list-and-cleanup-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14557](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14557-resident-can-skip-purity-check-when-fib-allocation-fails) — Resident can bypass its PURE protection check on FIB allocation failure.** With FORCE omitted, a null DOS_FIB skips the check and execution can continue to LoadSeg. Conditional on allocation failure and successful loading. [Full-body allocation pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#resident-shell-command-full-body-resident-list-and-cleanup-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14558](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14558-if-val-ignores-invalid-numeric-operands) — If VAL treats invalid numeric operands as zero.** `StrToLong()` reports no digits with `-1` and stores zero, but If ignores the status; malformed comparisons can take the wrong branch. [Full-body comparison pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#if-shell-command-full-body-comparison-and-skip-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14559](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14559-cd-ignores-current-directory-name-update-failure) — CD can change the directory lock but leave the shell's saved name stale.** It ignores `SetCurrentDirName()` failure, including paths beyond the setter's 255-byte limit, and reports success. [Full-body directory/name pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#cd-shell-command-full-body-directory-and-name-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14560](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14560-echo-first-on-empty-string-reads-before-argument) — Echo can read before an empty string argument.** With positive FIRST and a zero-length string, `l - 1` moves the pointer before the argument and the output loop dereferences it. Conditional on the shell passing an empty `/M` argument. [Full-body slicing pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#echo-shell-command-full-body-slicing-and-output-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14561](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14561-getenv-truncates-long-global-values) — Getenv, Get, Alias, Set and Unset silently truncate long variable values.** Their fixed GetVar buffers clip oversized global/local values, then the commands report success. Conditional on first lines longer than 255 bytes for Getenv/Get or 159 bytes for Alias/Unalias/Set/Unset. [Full-body value-length pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#getenv-shell-command-full-body-value-length-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14562](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14562-alias-mistakes-getvar-failure-for-success) — Alias treats GetVar’s -1 missing-variable result as true.** It then prints an uninitialized buffer and reports success for an undefined alias. [Full-body lookup pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#alias-shell-command-full-body-lookup-and-value-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14563](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14563-cut-dereferences-before-malformed-boundary-string) — Cut reads before malformed range text.** `getBoundaries()` adds StrToLong's `-1` failure result to its input pointer, then dereferences the preceding byte. Conditional on a nonnumeric CHAR/WORD range. [Full-body range pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#cut-shell-command-full-body-range-and-output-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14564](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14564-cut-ignores-output-write-errors) — Cut ignores FPutC failures and can return success after partial output.** Both range loops and the final newline discard write results. Conditional on output failure. [Full-body output pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#cut-shell-command-full-body-range-and-output-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14565](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14565-pathpart-directory-branch-copies-no-terminator) — PathPart copies a path without its NUL terminator before calling DOS PathPart().** The DOS routine scans for NUL, so the DIR branch reads beyond its allocation. [Full-body copy/bounds pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#pathpart-shell-command-full-body-copy-and-output-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14566](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14566-pathpart-ignores-output-errors) — PathPart ignores PutStr and FPutC failures and returns success.** Conditional on output failure in a successful DIR/FILE/ADD operation. [Full-body output pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#pathpart-shell-command-full-body-copy-and-output-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14567](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14567-skip-accepts-eof-without-endskip) — Skip reports success when its no-label search reaches EOF without EndSkip.** The final missing-target check applies only when LABEL was supplied. [Full-body script-flow pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#skip-shell-command-full-body-target-and-eof-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14568](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14568-info-overflows-filter-vector-while-adding-assignment-entries) — Info can overrun its fixed filter vector while expanding assignments.** Matching directory assigns append their linked path entries without a capacity check to a 128-pointer vector. [Full-body filter expansion recheck](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#info-filter-expansion-and-volume-list-full-body-recheck-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14569](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14569-info-dereferences-unmounted-volume-task-in-filter-pass) — Info dereferences a missing handler task for an unmounted volume.** The filtered pass dereferences `dol_Task` although the volume display path treats it as optional. [Full-body volume-list recheck](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#info-filter-expansion-and-volume-list-full-body-recheck-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14570](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14570-info-tests-before-the-first-byte-of-empty-assignment-filter) — Info reads before an empty assignment filter string.** Directory assign expansion inserts empty placeholders which the pattern matcher indexes at `len - 1`. [Full-body filter expansion recheck](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#info-filter-expansion-and-volume-list-full-body-recheck-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14571](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14571-waitforport-deletes-an-outstanding-timer-request) — WaitForPort frees timer I/O state on break without draining completion.** Break can leave an active timer request queued, or skip a reply already queued when timer and break signals arrive together. [Timer lifecycle and signal-overlap recheck](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#waitforport-break-and-timer-signal-overlap-recheck-gd14571). Source-only.

**[GD14572](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14572-waitforport-times-out-after-eleven-seconds) — WaitForPort waits an extra timer interval before timing out.** Its strict `>` check queues an eleventh second after the ten-second limit. [Full-body timeout pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#waitforport-full-body-timer-lifecycle-and-timeout-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14573](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14573-search-prefix-table-loop-wraps-for-long-literal) — Search's prefix-table loop wraps for long literal searches.** An 8-bit loop index wraps at 256 bytes while the UWORD length test remains true. [Full-body pattern pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#search-full-body-pattern-and-file-io-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14574](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14574-search-silently-skips-file-after-long-line-buffer-allocation-fails) — Search silently skips a file when its longest-line buffer allocation fails.** It frees the usable smaller buffer before the larger allocation and does not propagate failure. [Full-body file-I/O pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#search-full-body-pattern-and-file-io-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14575](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14575-load-command-sends-eject-operations) — Load sends eject operations on the selected ATA devices.** Both the direct SCSI CDB and selected ATA trackdisk callback issue eject-only operations regardless of the Load name. [Full-body Eject/Load pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#eject-load-full-body-dos-list-command-and-device-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14576](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14576-eject-finds-device-node-without-locking-dos-list) — Eject finds a DOS device node without locking the device list.** `LDF_READ` alone obtains no DOS-list lock, yet the command traverses and dereferences the returned node. [Full-body DOS-list pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#eject-load-full-body-dos-list-command-and-device-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14577](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14577-automount-returns-success-after-pref-or-mount-failure) — Automount returns success after preference or mount failures.** Several recorded error paths fall through to an unconditional successful process status. [Full-body preference/mount pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#automount-full-body-preference-and-mount-status-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14578](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14578-requestchoice-leaks-gadget-buffer-if-body-format-allocation-fails) — RequestChoice leaks its gadget buffer if body formatting allocation fails.** The function returns after the second allocation fails without freeing the first. [Full-body requester/buffer pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#requestchoice-full-body-requester-and-buffer-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14579](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14579-symboldump-calls-debug-library-after-failed-open) — SymbolDump calls debug.library after an unchecked open.** A missing library leaves `DebugBase` null, but enumeration is still called. [Full-body library/output pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#symboldump-full-body-library-and-output-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.

**[GD14580](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14580-symboldump-reports-success-when-output-is-unavailable) — SymbolDump reports success when it cannot write the symbol file.** It ignores output-open, FPrintf and Close failures and returns zero. [Full-body output pass](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#symboldump-full-body-library-and-output-pass-2026-11-03). Source-only.


**[OD3288](AROS-other-drivers.md#od3288) — Atheros5000 `S2_TRACKTYPE` allocation and failure paths mishandle tracker state.** A failed global-tracker allocation can leave a null source for `CopyMem()`; later failure paths also retain phantom tracker references. Source-only.


**[OD3294](AROS-other-drivers.md#od3294) — Atheros5000 reports failed transmissions as successful.** Data and management completion ignore nonzero HAL descriptor status and set `io_Error` to zero, even though supported HAL families report retry, filter, and FIFO errors. Source-only.


**[OD11205](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11205) — Atheros5000 leaks packet-type tracking allocations on close.** AROSTCP tracks packet types by default but closes without untracking; Atheros frees neither per-opener baselines nor remaining global tracker nodes. Source-only.

**[OD11206](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11206) — Ramdrive unit ports have uninitialized SMP queue locks.** Unit storage is allocated without clearing, and the embedded port lock is never initialized before ExecSMP `GetMsg()`/`PutMsg()` use. Source-only.

**[OD11207](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11207) — Ramdrive and FDisk ignore unit-task signal allocation failure.** If `AllocSignal(-1)` fails, the invalid result is stored in `mp_SigBit`; later `WaitPort()` and `PutMsg()` use it as a signal number, which can leave unit requests unprocessed. Conditional on signal exhaustion; source-only.

**[OD3743](AROS-other-drivers.md#od3743) — LPe32002 request-port allocation rollback can dereference NULL and leak ports.** Failure at queue 0 reaches an unconditional NULL slot write; later failures leave subsequent allocations untracked. Source-only.

**[OD3744](AROS-other-drivers.md#od3744) — LPe32002 ignores delay-timer setup and I/O failures.** Firmware polling continues without the intended delay after timer open/request failure and can time out prematurely. Source-only.

**[OD9749](AROS-other-drivers.md#od9749) — FEC request-port allocation failures fault unit creation or leave NULL queues.** The write queue is dereferenced after unchecked allocation; event/orphan queue failures later pass NULL to `PutMsg()`. Applies to the optional PowerPC FEC target; orphan requests require a direct/external client. Source-only.


**[OD3033](AROS-other-drivers.md#od3033) — E1000 request-port allocation failure faults unit creation and can leak ports.** The failed first queue remains NULL for an unconditional write-queue flag assignment; later failed construction may lose subsequent allocations. Explicit i386/x86_64 E1000 builds. Source-only.

**[OD3055](AROS-other-drivers.md#od3055) — PCNet32 and nForce request-port allocation failure faults unit construction.** Both set queue flags through the unchecked write-queue pointer after allocation; later failures can also strand subsequent ports. The active network aggregate selects PCNet32 for i386/x86_64 and nForce for i386 in standard Workbench builds (`workbench/devs/networks/mmakefile.src:3-15`; local target aliases in their manifests). Source-only.


**[EK10621](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10621) — Hyper-V debugger treats an absolute TSC timestamp as a task runtime duration.** The optional debugger converts the task dispatch timestamp directly to nanoseconds, producing an uptime-based/overflowed value in its `task` command. Source-only.


**[EK10622](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10622) — Hyper-V debugger walks scheduler lists without an SMP snapshot.** Its `tasklist` command traverses running, spinning, ready, and wait lists without locks while the NMI prompt leaves other CPUs running; overlapping scheduler updates can yield a partial walk or stale task access. Optional x86-64 PC ExecSMP debugger. Source-only.


**[EK10623](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10623) — Hyper-V debugger accepts command prefixes and dispatches every match.** Unknown input such as `taskextra` runs `task`, and `tasklist` can also invoke the shorter `task` handler if the first handler returns. Optional debugger. Source-only.

**[GD14582](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14582-gpio-command-accepts-unsupported-pin-numbers) — GPIO command reports success for unsupported pin numbers.** Invalid pins are silently ignored by the resource, while GET prints zero and the command returns success. Raspberry Pi resource/explicit command scope. Source-only.



**[GD14585](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14585-requeststring-never-frees-readargs-state) — RequestString leaks its ReadArgs state.** It never calls `FreeArgs()` after successful parsing, including after normal requester completion. Repeated invocations can retain argument allocations. Explicit `workbench-c-requeststring` target. Source-only.



**[GD14588](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14588-clip-wait-ignores-startnotify-failure) — Clip GET WAIT blocks after StartNotify fails.** Without a registered notification, it waits for a signal that cannot arrive. Explicit optional shell-command target. Source-only.

**[GD14589](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14589) — Clip can overflow its accumulated clipboard size.** On 64-bit builds, concatenated `CHRS` chunks exceeding 4 GiB wrap the 32-bit allocation size before a larger copy. Conditional on a very large clipboard payload; source-only.

**[GD14590](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14590) — Sound datatype disposal retries failed shutdown allocations forever.** If reply-port or exit-request allocation keeps failing, `Sound_DISPOSE()` never sends the player exit command or completes disposal. Conditional on persistent resource exhaustion; optional datatype target; source-only.

**OD2150 — IPMI SENSORS trusts short SDR reservation replies and can lose retry progress.** It reads an unchecked reservation ID, can use an uninitialized next-record ID after first-chunk invalidation, and can retry a later invalidated chunk without progress. See [OD2150](AROS-other-drivers.md#od2150-ipmi-sdr-reservation-validation-and-retry).

**OD2151 — IPMI SEL CLEAR reads reservation and erase status from unchecked short replies.** Short successful responses can leave the reservation and status reads uninitialized. See [OD2151](AROS-other-drivers.md#od2151-ipmi-sel-reservation-and-clear-status-lengths).

**[OD2784](AROS-other-drivers.md#od2784) — IPMI SENSORS can loop indefinitely on a multi-record SDR cycle.** A malformed BMC repository with a cycle that is not a self-link prevents the command from reaching its end marker. Source-only.

**[OD2363](AROS-other-drivers.md#od2363) — VirtIO returns CMD_UPDATE success without a negotiated flush.** AFS, SFS and NTFS use it as a synchronization step; when the device lacks FLUSH, no flush request is sent. Applies to the modern VirtIO path; no device without FLUSH was exercised. Source-only.

**OD2804 — IPMI SENSORS reads metadata from incomplete SDR records.** A zero-data successful chunk stops collection but parsing still reads sensor type and threshold bytes that were not received. See [OD2804](AROS-other-drivers.md#od2804-ipmi-sensors-parses-incomplete-sdr-records).

**OD1030 — IPMI sensor linear conversion overflows signed 32-bit arithmetic.** Valid sensor coefficients can exceed `LONG` in milli-units and produce a wrong reading. See [OD1030](AROS-other-drivers.md#od1030-ipmi-sensor-linear-conversion-overflows-long).

**OD1031 — IPMI sensor conversion truncates the offset before combining exponents.** A negative offset exponent can discard a value later restored by the range exponent. See [OD1031](AROS-other-drivers.md#od1031-ipmi-sensor-offset-truncates-before-exponent-combination).

**[OD4124](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4124) — USB-MIDI CAMD image generation accepts an empty or partial file.** Allocation or write failure can leave a stale file that later bindings accept without retrying. Its current CAMD load consequence is gated by OD4300. Source-only.

**[OD4300](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4300) — USB-MIDI CAMD bridge is rejected by AROS's driver-format check.** Its embedded driver sets `Flags=0`, while AROS CAMD rejects records without bit 0 before `Init()` or port registration. The optional class is affected when CAMD scans the generated image; late file creation after CAMD initialization is separately covered by OD4459. Source-only.

**[OD4301](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4301) — USB-MIDI CAMD callback declarations use the wrong register assignments.** If OD4300 is corrected or bypassed, CAMD supplies callback arguments in registers that the embedded wrapper does not read; ClosePort also continues after an out-of-range index. Optional USB-MIDI class; no unmodified-path reachability claimed. Source-only.

**[OD10148](AROS-other-drivers.md#od10148) — Bluetooth GATT re-enumeration can retain stale descriptor metadata.** A bound characteristic that keeps its value handle can keep old CCCD and HID Report Reference metadata while descriptor rediscovery remains marked complete. Trigger requires a peer-side database change during explicit LE re-enumeration. Source-only.

**[OD10149](AROS-other-drivers.md#od10149) — Bluetooth GATT descriptor errors are treated as successful absence.** Non-absence ATT, protocol, or timeout errors during descriptor discovery/Report Reference reads are swallowed, and enumeration continues with incomplete metadata. Conditional on an operation error; source-only.

**[OD10173](AROS-other-drivers.md#od10173) — CUE audio readers overflow signed length arithmetic for large valid streams.** FLAC, Vorbis, mpg123, and WavPack shift a signed 32-bit sample count left by two to obtain decoded byte length. Files with at least 536,870,912 sample frames reach signed overflow before track-sector sizing. Explicit CUE decoder targets; source-only.

**[OD10205](AROS-other-drivers.md#od10205) — DMS decoders read packed data without enforcing its declared extent.** Truncated mode data can make bit and RLE readers consume past the packed track extent and potentially beyond their 32-KiB input buffer. Explicit optional DMS plugin; malformed archive required.

**[OD10206](AROS-other-drivers.md#od10206) — DMS dictionary matches can write beyond the track output buffer.** A final match is not clamped to remaining output; at the accepted 32-KiB extent it can cross the allocation. Explicit optional DMS plugin; malformed archive required.

**[OD10207](AROS-other-drivers.md#od10207) — DMS HEAVY tree counts can overrun fixed code-length arrays.** Encoded counts are written before checking the 510-entry and 14/15-entry capacities. Explicit optional DMS plugin; malformed archive required.

**[GD10582](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd10582) — CHRP Radeon BIOS parsing trusts the OpenFirmware ROM property length.** On PCI-ROM fallback, a short valid-signature property is read at fixed BIOS offsets without checking `OF_GetPropLen()`. Source-only; conditional on truncated firmware data.

**[GD10583](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd10583) — Shared Radeon BIOS parsing trusts table offsets beyond the mapped ROM.** The PCI ROM size is discarded after mapping; signature-valid BIOS header and table offsets are then dereferenced without checking the source extent. Source-only; conditional on out-of-range ROM data.

**[GD10584](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd10584) — Radeon initialization uses failed PCI mappings without checking them.** Framebuffer, MMIO, and ROM mapping results all reach direct pointer consumers; PCIPC and PCILinux expose conditional mapping-failure paths. Source-only; explicit HIDD builds.


**[OD11208](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11208) — PCI host bridges accept BARs that only partially fit outbound windows.** BCM2711, BCM2712, and OpenSBI PCIDT check the BAR start but not its full extent. Conditional on a BAR crossing a configured window; source-only.


**[OD2565](AROS-other-drivers.md#od2565) — OpenSBI PCIDT ignores failed or truncated 64-bit BAR mappings.** A BAR map can fail or cover only part of the extent while PCIDT still returns a non-NULL address to its caller. Conditional on a matching BAR and firmware placement; source-only.


**[OD2563](AROS-other-drivers.md#od2563) — OpenSBI PCIDT assumes every FDT `ranges` tuple has seven cells.** A fixed seven-cell parser can omit or misread PCI `ranges` tuples when the parent address width differs. Conditional on FDT cell counts; source-only.


**[OD2564](AROS-other-drivers.md#od2564) — OpenSBI PCIDT ACPI fallback ignores failed high-BAR mappings.** The ACPI fallback ignores a rejected high-BAR mapping and can pass its unchanged address to NVMe. Conditional on high BAR placement; source-only.


**[OD2566](AROS-other-drivers.md#od2566) — OpenSBI PCIDT does not translate nonidentity 32-bit memory windows.** A nonidentity 32-bit PCI memory window is mapped at its CPU base, but `MapPCI()` returns the untranslated PCI address. Conditional on FDT mapping; source-only.


**[OD2567](AROS-other-drivers.md#od2567) — OpenSBI PCIDT retains only the last 64-bit FDT PCI window.** Only the last 64-bit FDT PCI window is retained for BAR mapping, translation, and DWC ATU setup. Conditional on multiple windows; source-only.


**[OD3982](AROS-other-drivers.md#od3982) — OpenSBI PCIDT skips mapping low-address 64-bit BARs.** A low-address 64-bit BAR in the retained MEM64 window is skipped by boot-time mapping but later translated to a CPU pointer. Conditional; source-only.


**[OD3983](AROS-other-drivers.md#od3983) — OpenSBI PCIDT can expose BARs beyond its DesignWare outbound ATU span.** DWC outbound ATU setup can cover less than the retained MEM64 range, while BAR mapping exposes the full range. Conditional on uncovered BAR placement; source-only.


**[OD11209](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11209) — OpenSBI PCIDT skips unassigned I/O BAR allocation without a MEM32 window.** Its early MEM32 guard prevents the later I/O allocation branch from running. Conditional on an I/O-only FDT window and an unassigned endpoint I/O BAR; source-only.


**[OD11210](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11210) — OpenSBI PCIDT enables BAR decoding after an allocation does not fit.** A BAR stays at zero when its full extent exceeds the window, but the endpoint Command register still enables I/O and memory decoding. Conditional on an unassigned BAR that does not fit; source-only.


**[OD11211](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11211) — OpenSBI PCIDT assigns child BARs without programming subordinate bridge windows.** Child endpoints can receive enabled BARs behind a bridge that does not forward their transactions. Conditional on an FDT hierarchy with unconfigured subordinate windows; source-only.


**[OD11212](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11212) — OpenSBI PCIDT does not translate or forward PCI I/O BARs.** The host leaves `IOBase` at zero, and DesignWare outbound setup creates memory windows only. Conditional on an FDT I/O aperture and an I/O-BAR client; source-only.

**[OD11213](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11213) — OpenSBI PCIDT can mix ACPI interrupt routes across PCI segments.** The fallback matches host bridges by bus range but ignores MCFG segment identity. Conditional on overlapping bus ranges with distinct `_PRT` routes; source-only.

**[OD11214](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11214) — OpenSBI PCIDT can program a wrapped DesignWare MEM32 ATU limit.** A boundary-crossing FDT window is programmed with only the end address low dword; conditional on the range and a BAR in the uncovered portion; source-only.

**[OD11215](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11215) — OpenSBI PCIDT keeps address windows after their CPU mapping fails.** It ignores `PCIDT_Map()` failure and later returns identity addresses for BARs; conditional on a high I/O/MEM32 aperture; source-only.

**[OD11216](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11216) — OpenSBI PCIDT drops ACPI PCI interrupt routes to GSI 0 because zero is also its no-route value. Conditional on an ACPI fallback with a device routed to GSI 0 and an unset `INT_LINE`; source-only.**



**[OD2590](AROS-other-drivers.md#od2590) — OpenSBI DesignWare I²C `ProbeAddress` ignores the supplied direction and performs a one-byte read. Conditional on targets that NACK reads or have read side effects; source-only.**


**[OD11217](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11217) — OpenSBI battclock selects the first M41T11 node without checking `status`. Conditional on a disabled first node preceding a usable enabled RTC; source-only.**


**[OD11218](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11218) — OpenSBI battclock may mistake a preceding I²C mux for the parent bus of a later direct RTC. Conditional on FDT child ordering; source-only.**

SDL bitmap caller-pass update (GD9833 scope expanded; 2026-11-03): confirmed the SDL bitmap `PutTemplate()` override dispatches all destination storage widths to the same generic mask helpers that read the next word after the requested last bit. The existing GD9833 final-word overread therefore also applies to explicitly built SDL-backed bitmaps. Reconciled `PutAlphaImage()` callers in cursor rendering, CyberGraphX and Compositor; source ARGB32 masks, four-byte pitch, and clipping/offset calculations match the method's expected layout. Unchecked SDL surface creation remains unpromoted because the host implementation's NULL behavior is absent from this checkout. See [GD9833](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd9833) and the [SDL caller/configuration trace](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#sdl-hidd-template-helper-and-alpha-image-caller-reconciliation-gd9833-scope-expanded-no-new-od-or-fileloc-credit-2026-11-03). No body or LOC totals changed; source-only.

**[OD11234](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11234) — Nouveau R535 display oneinit failure skips RM client teardown.** If a later R535 display initialization step fails after the GSP RM client/device are created, oneinit failure leaves `use.enabled` false, so cleanup skips the RM teardown before the containing display object is freed; the client IDR can temporarily retain a pointer into freed storage. Conditional on a later RM/resource failure in selected TU102/GA102 GSP display setup. Source-only.

**[OD11235](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11235) — GM20B clock initialization overwrites its computed DVFS state with zeros.** On GM20B speedo >= 1, if startup voltage maps to the lowest VID, a final initialization call programs the zero-initialized pending state over the computed detector coefficient; the equal-voltage initial P-state skips correction. Conditional Tegra clock-state candidate; source-only.

**[OD11236](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11236) — NV50 auxiliary clock divider overflows its three-bit field below the minimum rate.** A BIOS-requested VDEC or DOM6 rate between `src/256` and `src/128` yields divider 8, which truncates to zero in the three-bit register field and can select the undivided source. Conditional on VBIOS state data and selected G84-family reclocking; source-only.

**[OD11237](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11237) — GT215 clock calculation divides by zero for absent auxiliary rates.** A selected GT215-family state with zero display/VDEC rate reaches an unguarded divider calculation; supported PERF v0x25 decoding can leave those domains zero. Conditional BIOS/state applicability; source-only.

**[OD11238](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11238) — Nouveau clock backends ignore PLL lock timeouts.** GF100/GK104 continue source selection after timeout; MCP77 returns success while leaving the safe clock source selected. Applies conditionally to those chipset families when a selected PLL fails to lock; hardware behavior untested.

**[OD11239](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11239) — GK20A/GM20B initial clock read divides by zero when PLL M is unset.** The base initializer reads the GPC clock before backend init; zero M makes the shared PLL-rate reader divide by zero. Conditional on pre-init register state; source-only.

**[OD11243](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11243) — GK104 PWM voltage setter divides by unchecked BIOS fields.** A selected v0x50 PWM table with zero frequency after unit conversion or zero range reaches integer division by zero during a voltage update. Firmware applicability remains unverified; source-only.

**[OD2447](AROS-other-drivers.md#od2447) — AHI unit startup failure can free the worker state before child cleanup.** After a worker startup failure, it replies before cleanup; the opener may free the shared unit first, leaving the child to access released state. Conditional on scheduling overlap; source-only.

**[OD2448](AROS-other-drivers.md#od2448) — AHI unit startup failure leaks the allocated voice array.** Failures creating the reply port/worker or during child resource setup free the unit but omit the separately allocated voice array. Conditional allocation/setup failure; source-only.
**[GD14734](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14734) — Optional vmwgfx GEM teardown never destroys its device-wide object-name IDR, retaining lock state and potentially cached IDR layers.** Active when the optional VMware driver initializes GEM; source-only.
**[GD14735](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14735) — Optional vmwgfx CRTC setup ignores gamma-table allocation failure and continues with legacy gamma disabled.** Conditional on allocation failure; source-only.
**[GD14736](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14736) — Optional vmwgfx universal cursor-plane setup ignores hotspot-property allocation failure while hotspot support stays enabled.** Atomic virtualized cursor clients then cannot set the hotspot used in pointer positioning; conditional on allocation failure; source-only.

**GD14737 — vmwgfx can dereference a NULL suggested-position property during display setup:** `vmw_kms_init()` ignores failure creating the suggested X/Y properties; all three connector constructors later attach them without checking, and the helper dereferences the pointer. Trigger requires allocation failure during property creation. See [GD14737](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14737) and the [caller trace](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#vmwgfx-suggested-position-properties-gd14737). Source-only.

**GD14738 — Optional DP AUX backlight helper reports failed control writes as success:** with backlight-class integration enabled, an AUX enable/disable failure is ignored, and a failed enable is recorded as enabled so later brightness updates do not retry it until another blank/unblank cycle. The exported helper has no checked-in caller in this tree. See [GD14738](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14738) and the [callback/error trace](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#dp-aux-backlight-callback-error-state-gd14738). Source-only.

**GD14739 — Mesa GLAPI can overwrite another pthread TLS value when key allocation is exhausted:** the Mesa 26 AROS patch ignores failed `pthread_key_create()` calls and leaves the static key as zero; AROS supports 64 keys, and subsequent GLAPI writes can alias allocated key zero. See [GD14739](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14739) and the [GLAPI/pthread failure trace](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#mesa-26-glapi-pthread-key-exhaustion-gd14739). Source-only.

**GD14740 — VC4 Mesa render-scale can leave viewport/scissor state in the wrong units after framebuffer switches:** conversion happens only when the API state is set, based on the currently bound framebuffer; persistent state is not converted on later target changes. See [GD14740](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14740) and the [render-scale patch/configuration trace](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#mesa-26-vc4-render-scale-viewport-scissor-state-gd14740). Source-only; Mesa source bodies are not in this checkout.

**GD14741 — Mesa 26 `CPU_TO_LE32` reverses values on little-endian AROS:** its AROS definition always byte-swaps, despite i386/AArch64 AROS being little-endian. See [GD14741](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14741) and the [Mesa patch/endian definitions](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#mesa-26-endian-conversion-gd14741). Imported Mesa call sites are unavailable in this checkout.

**GD10142 — NListtree retains stale disclosure state after a canceled click:** outside release leaves the saved node pending; if a client removes it before a later in-widget release, the handler dereferences the freed node. No checked-in caller was established for that inter-event removal sequence. See [GD10142](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd10142). Source-only; no GUI event was run.

**GD14742 — MST encryption-status parser accepts a truncated reply as success:** the parser reads status fields without validating the received length, and the transaction path ignores parser failure. See [GD14742](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14742) and the [MST receive/consumer trace](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#mst-sideband-reply-parser-pass-gd14742). No checked-in caller of the exported API was found; both vendored helper copies have the same parser defect, and the Nouveau copy is in an optional target excluded from the default build graph. A caller impact requires an external API client and a malformed short MST reply.

- **[EK10627](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10627)** — On Raspberry Pi 4/5, the AArch64 timer counts one EClock tick per 50 Hz scheduler heartbeat but reports 100 Hz by default. EClock-based elapsed-time conversions can be about half the real duration. Avoided by `eclock=50`; source-only. See the [fallback-rate trace](AROS-exec-kernel-coverage.md#raspberry-pi-eclock-fallback-rate-ek10627).
**GD14745 — AMDX beta pipeline-node wrapper comparisons can call `strcmp` with a null `pName`:** default construction leaves `pName` null, and equality/ordering call `strcmp` when pointers differ. Scoped to C++ clients enabling `VK_ENABLE_BETA_EXTENSIONS`; no in-tree caller was identified in the inspected tree. See [GD14745](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14745) and the [wrapper comparison trace](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md#vulkan-hpp-amdx-beta-node-wrapper-comparison-finding-gd14745).

**GD14746 — VC4 overlay teardown releases its scanout BO before the HVS list latches:** the HVS4 clear path rebuilds the list without waiting for vblank, then VC4 drops the BO pin. See [GD14746](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14746).

**GD14747 — VC4 BO allocation retry can overwrite a concurrently allocated handle:** OOM reclaim drops the handle-table lock without reserving the selected slot, then retries into that slot. See [GD14747](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14747).

**GD14748 — VC4 OOM reclaim frees frame pools outside the submission lock:** a new submission can race pool reclamation after the reclaim wait releases `render_lock`. See [GD14748](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14748).

**GD14749 — VC4 dirty-exit reclaim frees BOs while the previous GPU job may still run:** the next task's startup sweep waits for DMA only before releasing V3D BOs and frame pools. See [GD14749](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14749).

**GD14750 — Generic HIDD bitmap stride rounds wide dimensions to zero:** with default 16-pixel alignment, true-color bitmap widths 65,521–65,535 truncate the aligned row width to zero and make `AllocBitMap()` fail. See [GD14750](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14750).

**[OD11240](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11240) — DiskImage failed unit startup can free the worker's return message before its final read.** On an explicitly built AROS DiskImage device with ExecSMP, if early worker initialization fails and the opener runs on another CPU, it can consume the embedded death reply and free the unit before the worker reads its return value from that message. Conditional source-level use-after-free; no failure or schedule was induced. See the [startup caller trace](AROS-other-drivers-coverage.md#diskimage-selected-aros-open-startup-return-message-caller-pass-od11240).

**[EK10628](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10628) — The generic timer and Efika override accept `UNIT_ECLOCK` and `UNIT_WAITECLOCK` but do not reply to non-quick `TR_ADDREQUEST` requests on those unsupported units, so synchronous callers can block indefinitely. The m68k override handles both units. Source-only.**

**[OD9957](AROS-other-drivers.md#od9957) — Optional VUSBHCI marks a unit busy and returns success after detecting an undersized Open request.**

**[OD11241](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11241) — Optional VUSBHCI advertises USBOPER/USBRESUME/USBSUSPEND but returns success without changing bus state or reporting the documented state. No active in-tree caller was established.**


**[GD14751](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14751) — Optional BMP datatype drops the partial final packed pixel byte on 1-, 2-, and 4-bit image rows.**

**[GD14752](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14752) — Optional BMP datatype writes zero-length pixel rows for its advertised 1- and 4-bit raw output.**


**[GD14753](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14753) — Optional BMP datatype accepts truncated pixel arrays as successful loads.**

**[GD14754](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14754) — Optional BMP datatype ignores header and palette write failures and can report a corrupt save as successful.**


**[GD14755](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14755) — On 32-bit builds, optional BMP loader can accept a pixel offset before the header/palette and use its wrapped value.**

**[GD14756](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14756) — BMP loader signature check accepts a file if only one of the two expected bytes matches.** It may parse a non-BMP file with a sufficiently BMP-like header; optional standalone datatype, low impact.

**[GD14758](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14758) — Generic HIDD bitmap row alignment uses a power-of-two mask without documenting or validating that restriction; non-power-of-two alignment requests can produce a stride that violates the requested alignment.**
**[GD14757](AROS-graphics-desktop.md#gd14757) — BMP loader treats valid top-down image heights as unsigned.** On 32-bit builds, a negative BI_RGB height becomes a large UWORD picture height and the signed row loop can skip decoding while reporting success. Optional datatype; source-only.


**[OD9958](AROS-other-drivers.md#od9958) — Optional VUSBHCI string descriptor handling repeats the header, treats byte length as a UTF-16 element count, and can exceed the second-stage buffer.**


**[OD9959](AROS-other-drivers.md#od9959) — Optional VUSBHCI dereferences the active USB configuration after lookup failure.**

**[OD9960](AROS-other-drivers.md#od9960) — Optional VUSBHCI does not handle async transfer allocation/submission failures; requests can remain pending without completion.**

**[OD9961](AROS-other-drivers.md#od9961) — Optional VUSBHCI reports an uninitialized error when a control transfer returns an unrecognized negative result.**


**[EK10629](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10629) — m68k timer's WAITUNTIL path inverts the expired-time check and compares an absolute deadline with uptime ticks; future WaitX date/time requests can complete immediately.**


**[EK10630](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10630) — m68k GetSysTime compares fractional microseconds against the previous seconds field, so its monotonicity tweak can grow on every call and produce clock drift or an unnormalized timeval.**

**[EK10631](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10631) — m68k VBlank delays wrap when converted to a 32-bit frame count.** Normalized delays above about 2.3 years at 60 Hz or 2.7 years at 50 Hz become short delays after unsigned overflow; no maximum is enforced. Conditional long-duration timer bug; source-only.

**[OD11242](AROS-other-drivers.md#od11242) — The selected Workbench DEBUG handler does not terminate converted non-ASCII writes before `%s` formatting, so stale tail bytes can be printed or the scan can pass the buffer.**

**[OD4428](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4428) — PTP failed-upload cleanup frees the object before releasing its file handle.**

**[OD4427](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4427) — Successful PTP move relinks the object without updating its cached parent.**

**[OD4426](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4426) — Optional PTP filesystem can search a rename using an uninitialized path and conditionally move the wrong cached object while returning an error.**

**[OD4456](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4456) — PTP treats failed directory fetches as a path miss or end of directory.**

**[OD4453](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4453) — PTP startup does not retry volume registration after a lock miss.**

**[OD4454](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4454) — PTP startup reports success or publishes a volume after session-open failure.**

**[OD4458](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4458) — PTP zero-length writes return the packet default instead of a byte count.**

**[OD4457](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4457) — PTP response readers accept transaction-ID mismatches after logging them.**

**[OD4455](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4455) — PTP delete maps a stale remote object handle to a generic disk error.**

**[OD4452](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4452) — PTP stores an out-of-range seek position after reporting failure.**

**[OD4451](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4451) — PTP binding-list access uses only processor-local Forbid protection.**

**[OD4450](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4450) — PTP examination block-count rounding overflows near the 4-GiB size limit.**

**[OD4423](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4423) — PTP startup ignores DeviceInfo failure and uses an unset root name.**

**[OD4424](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4424) — PTP directory loading marks partial metadata results as permanently fetched.**

**[OD4425](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4425) — PTP format failure returns before committing refreshed storage records.**

**[OD4444](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4444) — PTP read/write range checks can wrap near the 4-GiB boundary.**

**[OD4440](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4440) — PTP startup converts an unchecked fixed-width DOS name into a bounded BSTR area.**

**[OD4443](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4443) — PTP read/write callers trust requested lengths after shorter data responses.**

**[OD4441](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4441) — A transient DOS-list lock failure can strand PTP interface release.**

**[OD4449](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4449) — Invalid PTP metadata dates can remain zero instead of taking the parser fallback.**

**[OD4448](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4448) — PTP response-data error cleanup frees a borrowed destination.**

**[OD4447](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4447) — PTP startup dereferences a failed model-string allocation.**

**[OD4445](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4445) — PTP write-buffer growth can loop forever when its increment wraps.**

**[OD4446](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4446) — Successful PTP storage-info parsing leaks its response buffer.**

**[OD4431](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4431) — PTP accepts writes through read-only handles and misclassifies update handles.**

**[OD4430](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4430) — PTP in-range writes to existing files reach data handling without a buffer.**

**[OD4432](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4432) — PTP object metadata serialization can exceed its fixed 1,024-byte buffer.**

**[OD4434](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4434) — PTP CreateDir returns the packet success sentinel when lock allocation fails.**

**[OD4433](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4433) — PTP overwrite handling reads an object record after freeing it.**

**[OD4437](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4437) — PTP ExNext retains a child pointer after delete or replacement frees it.**

**[OD4435](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4435) — PTP examination leaves a previous comment in a reused FileInfoBlock.**

**[OD4436](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4436) — PTP disk information can wrap aggregate block totals across many large storage units.**

**[OD4439](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4439) — PTP object records with failed name allocations are still published.**

**[OD4422](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4422) — PTP volume-name filtering continues reading after the model string terminator.**

**[OD4421](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4421) — PTP array element-count validation can wrap before conversion.**

**[OD4420](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4420) — PTP metadata parsers read fields and strings without checking the response payload boundary.**

**[OD4419](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4419) — PTP startup inserts a failed storage-info result into its storage list.**

**[OD4418](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4418) — PTP response reader copies the final partial transfer from the pipe object instead of its receive buffer.**

**[OD4417](AROS-other-drivers.md#od4417) — Optional PTP response reader requests 12 bytes beyond an exact-size DOS read buffer during continuation; undersized responses can also underflow continuation sizing.**
**Graphics/Desktop Vulkan-Hpp progress (2026-11-03):** reviewed the video format, quantization-map, profile-list, query, intra-refresh, session-creation, memory-requirement and session-parameter wrappers (`vulkan_structs.hpp:172048-173350`). No new candidate; no body/path/LOC credit. See the [coverage ledger](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md). Source-only; no Vulkan operation or build was run.
**Graphics/Desktop optional VC4 DRM follow-up (2026-11-03):** rechecked remaining BO/ioctl teardown code and traced Mesa map/wait and tiling callers. GD14748 and GD14749 were confirmed; the lockless WAIT_BO snapshot remains unpromoted because the overlapping shared-resource caller synchronization contract was not established. No body/path/LOC credit. See the [coverage ledger](AROS-graphics-desktop-coverage.md). Source-only; no GPU or Mesa operation was run.
<a id="ek10632"></a>**EK10632 — POSIXC `access()`, `remove()`/`unlink()`, `rmdir()`, `rename()`, and `opendir()` fail to check Unix-to-Amiga path-conversion results. A `/.attbin` check or path-buffer allocation failure can fault instead of returning the recorded error; `rename()` also misses its old-path duplication failure. Scoped to Unix-path POSIXC; source-only. See [finding](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10632) and [coverage](AROS-exec-kernel-coverage.md#posixc-access-full-body-and-path-conversion-failure-pass-ek10632).

<a id="ek10633"></a>**EK10633 — POSIXC creation APIs ignore requested modes and saved `umask`.** Created object protection is left to the DOS handler default, regardless of caller permission bits or `umask()` value, including `mkstemp()`’s owner-only request. Exact default is handler-dependent. See [finding](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10633) and [coverage](AROS-exec-kernel-coverage.md#posixc-mkdir-mode-and-umask-review-ek10633). Source-only.

<a id="ek10634"></a>**EK10634 — POSIXC path and filesystem-stat APIs dereference failed path-conversion or result-buffer allocations (`getcwd()`, `realpath()`, `statfs()`, `getfsstat()`, `basename()`, `dirname()`, and Unix-style startup `argv[0]`).** Conversion allocation failure can fault instead of returning an error. See [finding](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10634) and [coverage](AROS-exec-kernel-coverage.md#posixc-path-conversion-allocation-failure-review-ek10634). Source-only.

<a id="ek10635"></a>**EK10635 — POSIXC `symlink()` rewrites existing targets as absolute paths.** Relative symlink targets that exist at creation lose their original relative meaning if the link is later moved. See [finding](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10635) and [coverage](AROS-exec-kernel-coverage.md#posixc-symlink-target-preservation-review-ek10635). Source-only.

<a id="ek10636"></a>**EK10636 — POSIXC `fchdir()` dereferences invalid or closed descriptor lookup results.** It can fault before returning the expected `EBADF`. See [finding](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10636) and [coverage](AROS-exec-kernel-coverage.md#posixc-fchdir-invalid-descriptor-review-ek10636). Source-only.

<a id="ek10637"></a>**EK10637 — POSIXC `fstatat()`, `unlinkat()`, and `fchmodat()` silently ignore unsupported flag bits.** Invalid requests can still stat, remove, or change permissions instead of failing with `EINVAL`. See [finding](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10637) and [coverage](AROS-exec-kernel-coverage.md#posixc-at-wrapper-flag-validation-review-ek10637). Source-only.

<a id="ek10638"></a>**EK10638 — POSIXC `statvfs()` skips Unix-to-Amiga path conversion.** Absolute POSIX paths can be passed to DOS as current-directory-relative names. See [finding](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10638) and [coverage](AROS-exec-kernel-coverage.md#posixc-statvfs-path-and-error-review-ek10638). Source-only.

<a id="ek10639"></a>**EK10639 — POSIXC `statvfs()` maps every DOS lock failure to `ENOENT`.** Access and handler errors are reported as missing paths. See [finding](AROS-exec-kernel.md#ek10639) and [coverage](AROS-exec-kernel-coverage.md#posixc-statvfs-path-and-error-review-ek10638). Source-only.
